queries.statement:
SELECT
  user_id,
  email,
  country,
  signup_ts,
  is_active
FROM raw.users
WHERE
  is_active

root_cause.rationale: No reasoner configured. The evidence chain is sufficient, so this is NOT a refusal — the question was never asked.
root_cause.statement: raw.users.user_id was renamed upstream. The database now exposes customer_id, email, country, signup_ts, is_active; the dbt model stg_users still selects user_id by name, so it fails to build (exit 1). Derived deterministically from runtime evidence — NOT produced by a language model (Diagnostician verdict: REASONER_UNAVAILABLE).

policy.allowed_action: propose + validate; apply only after owner approval
policy.rationale: Even a one-line fix changes a production model. DevGuard proposes and proves; a human decides.
policy.approval_note: Reviewed the diff on devguard/fix-d6105859; validated in analytics_devguard_check before approval.

--- a/substrate/dbt/models/staging/stg_users.sql
+++ b/substrate/dbt/models/staging/stg_users.sql
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@
 -- column to customer_id, this model fails to compile — a real dbt failure with a
 -- real error message, which is the runtime evidence the Watcher picks up.
 select
-    user_id,
+    customer_id as user_id,
     email,
     country,
     signup_ts,
